summary: issue-559-adopt-unobservable-removal: harden VariantIntent::Adopt against durable pre-553 candidate payloads whose scope diff carries Removed writes for kinds outside the gateway resource/effect model

A stored candidate edited by a pre-553 wire send.remove (send-owned ModulationSource/ModulationAssignment present) still adopts: plan_adopt_writes turns the unobservable deletions into Removed writes and post-simulation derive_effects/authorize_effects never sees those kinds

Reproduction confirmed on pre-fix code: cb_strip_559 repro test passed with AdoptOutcome::Applied; live send, send-owned LFO source, SendLevel target and ModulationAssignment all removed; recorded in evidence/sv559/reproduction.md
Reject unobservable removals at the gateway prepare/effect layer instead of the domain planner

Rejected gateway-layer placement: plan_adopt_writes is where the exact ObjectKind about to become a Removed write is known and where SEC-14 fail-closed already lives (Unsupported/AmbiguousLineage); a gateway-side kind filter would duplicate policy downstream of the owner boundary

Adopted domain boundary: entity::unverifiable_removal_kind matches only ModulationSource|ModulationAssignment and plan_adopt_writes returns typed VariantError::UnverifiableRemoval before constructing the write; RoutingConnection deliberately excluded because the sv#550 send-teardown contract removes the dedicated edge as internal structure of the observable Send delete (mirrors op_facts RemoveSend arm)

Related live-path gap found: SetSendGainTarget rebind calls release_send_level_target which deletes ModulationAssignments, but its op_facts arm does not flag them as unverifiable; wire-legal candidate edits could carry assignment removals. Out of scope for this slice — recorded for synvelis#561

Pins: cb_strip_559_adopt_unobservable_removal_rejected (domain) and cb06_strip_559_adopt_unobservable_removal_denied (gateway wire path) pass; cb06 suites keep 550/553/557 pins green; mise check/lint/test for synvelis-project and synvelis-gateway, fmt-check, check-headless-deps and prek all exit 0

Adopt now fails closed on standalone unobservable removals with a typed variant-unverifiable-removal reason; valid observable send teardown (incl. its routing edge) still materializes. Issue #559 remains open; commit/PR text uses Refs only
